title: Qui vive
html_source:
Literally (Fr.) “who lives?” Expression meaning on the alert or on the lookout.
First used late 16th century: From French, literally ‘(long) live who?,’ i.e., ‘on whose side are you?,’ used as a sentry’s challenge.
